Listen To The Beautiful Evergreen Kannada Audio Song “Nagalarade Alalarade” From The Classic Movie Shruthi Seridaga, Featuring Legendary Actor Dr. Rajkumar And Madhavi. With The Timeless Musical Brilliance Of T. G. Lingappa, This Memorable Melody Brings Back The Nostalgic Charm Of Golden-Era Kannada Cinema.
Relive The Golden Era Of Kannada Film Music With This Timeless Classic. Perfect For Fans Of Dr. Rajkumar Songs, Old Kannada Songs, Madhavi Songs, T. G. Lingappa Melodies, Evergreen Kannada Songs And Classic Kannada Movie Music.
Song: Nagalarade Alalarade
Album/Movie: Shruthi Seridaga
